en.headline: Major Sports Events Committee awards M Mark to three international tournaments
en.dek: The Link Hong Kong Open, Hong Kong Cricket Sixes and Prudential Hong Kong Tennis Open receive the status for events later this month and next.
body: The Major Sports Events Committee has awarded M Mark status to three international competitions scheduled in the coming weeks.

The events are the Link Hong Kong Open 2026, set for 22 to 25 October at the Hong Kong Golf Club in Fanling; the Hong Kong Cricket Sixes 2026 from 30 October to 1 November; and the Prudential Hong Kong Tennis Open 2026 between 31 October and 8 November at Victoria Park.

Committee chairman Wilfred Ng said the tournaments would bring world-class players to Hong Kong and demonstrate the city's ability to host diverse international competitions. He noted they would offer experiences to residents and tourists while reinforcing Hong Kong's position as a capital for major sports events.
The M Mark system supports local national sports associations and organisers in staging major international events. Some events also receive funding support under the scheme.

zh.headline: 大型體育活動事務委員會授予三項國際賽事M品牌認證
zh.dek: 領展香港高爾夫球公開賽、香港六人板球賽及保誠香港網球公開賽獲認證，分別於本月底及下月初舉行。
body: 大型體育活動事務委員會已向三項即將舉行的國際賽事授予M品牌認證。
有關賽事包括10月22日至25日在粉嶺香港高爾夫球會舉行的領展香港公開賽2026、10月30日至11月1日的香港六人板球賽2026，以及10月31日至11月8日在維多利亞公園舉行的保誠香港網球公開賽2026。
委員會主席伍衛國表示，這些賽事將匯聚世界級選手，展示香港舉辦多元化國際比賽的能力，並為居民及旅客帶來精彩體驗，鞏固本港作為大型國際體育活動之都的地位。
M品牌制度旨在支持本地體育總會及主辦機構舉辦大型國際賽事，部分活動亦會獲得資助。
